children: Glucotrack entered a settlement with Alto and related parties to resolve disputes tied to an asserted $10.9 million indebtedness. The company will pay $2.0 million in cash, issue a $2.0 million 5% convertible note amortizing through Aug. 31, 2027, and cover up to $125,000 of Alto’s legal fees. The note is convertible at $2.98 per share, subject to a 9.99% ownership cap and Nasdaq limits. Missed payments beyond the five-business-day cure may accelerate obligations and allow Alto to pursue remedies, while mutual releases become effective upon full payment.
